Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

The invention relates to a filter device with a filter element (1) which can be received in a filter housing that consists of at least two interconnectable housing parts (17, 19). The filter element (1) can be fixed to a housing part (19) in a removable manner by means of a screw connection (32, 33), and an additional screw connection (17, 41) is provided for connecting the housing parts (17, 19). The invention is characterized in that in order to transmit a torque between threaded elements (33) of the screw connection (32, 33) and of the additional screw connection (41), said threaded elements being rotatable relative to each other, a coupling device (43, 46, 61) is added which allows an additional rotational movement of the threaded element (17) of the additional screw connection (41) when the threaded element (33) of the screw connection (32, 33) reaches the fixed rotational state.

outputs.L3:
The invention relates to a filter device comprising a filter element arranged within a housing formed by at least two interconnected housing parts. The filter element is removably secured to one of the housing parts by means of a first screw connection, while the housing parts themselves are joined by a separate, second screw connection.

A coupling device is provided between the relatively rotatable threaded elements of the two screw connections. This coupling device transmits torque between the threaded elements, thereby coordinating the attachment or removal of the filter element with the assembly or disassembly of the housing parts. Once the screw connection securing the filter element reaches its end position and is prevented from rotating further, the coupling device allows the threaded element of the housing connection to continue rotating. In this way, the housing parts can be fully tightened or loosened without over-tightening or damaging the screw connection that secures the filter element.
outputs.L4:
A filter device comprises a housing formed from at least two housing parts and a replaceable filter element arranged within the housing. The filter element is removably secured to a first housing part by a first screw connection, while the housing parts are joined to one another by a separate second screw connection. The threaded elements of the two screw connections are rotatable relative to each other and are operatively connected by a coupling device that transmits torque during assembly.

When one housing part is rotated relative to the other, the coupling device initially transfers the applied torque to the threaded element associated with the filter element. The first screw connection is thereby tightened until the filter element reaches a predetermined fixed or end position on the first housing part. After this position has been reached, the coupling device allows relative rotation between the threaded elements, so that further rotation continues to tighten the second screw connection without subjecting the filter element to additional tightening torque. The housing parts can therefore be securely joined and sealed while avoiding excessive loading, deformation, or damage to the filter element. During disassembly, the separate screw connections likewise permit the housing to be opened and the filter element to be removed and replaced in a controlled manner.

### The Power of “The”

“The” is one of the smallest yet most frequently used words in the English language. Known as the definite article, it identifies a specific person, place, object, or idea. For example, “the book” refers to a particular book, while “a book” may mean any book.

Although it often goes unnoticed, “the” adds clarity and precision to communication. It helps listeners and readers understand exactly what is being discussed. This simple word demonstrates how even the smallest elements of language can carry significant meaning.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise patent-style abstract for an invention involving a removable filter element, a multipart filter housing, two screw connections, and a torque-transmitting coupling device.
counterfactuals.output: A filter assembly comprises a removable filter element disposed within a multipart filter housing having first and second housing portions. A first screw connection releasably joins the housing portions, and a second screw connection releasably secures the filter element within the housing. A torque-transmitting coupling device operatively couples the first and second screw connections such that rotation applied during assembly or disassembly of the housing is transmitted to the filter element connection. The coupling device facilitates coordinated installation and removal of the filter element while permitting separation of the housing portions for servicing.

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention in which a filter element is screwed to one housing part, the housing parts are connected by another threaded joint, and a coupling permits continued rotation after the first joint becomes fixed.
counterfactuals.output:
The invention is a filter assembly with two housing parts joined by a threaded connection. A replaceable filter element is attached to one housing part by a separate screw thread. Between the filter element and that housing part is a rotary coupling—such as a slip, overrunning, or ratchet coupling.

During assembly, rotation initially screws the filter element into place. When that threaded joint reaches its stop or specified tightening torque, the coupling releases or overruns, allowing the housing part to continue rotating relative to the now-fixed filter element. The second threaded joint can therefore be fully tightened to close and seal the housing without overtightening, twisting, or damaging the filter element. On disassembly, the coupling may re-engage in the opposite direction so that opening the housing also unscrews and removes the filter element.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4
